page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated physical cores and 96 vCPUs, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369HB processors operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The system is configured with a single thread per core. It is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. There are no integrated graphics processing units or specialized hardware accelerators bundled with this configuration.

Given the high memory allocation of 768.0 GB alongside 96 dedicated physical cores, this instance offers high resource density for memory-intensive workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures predictable performance without resource contention. It is designed for enterprise-grade workloads such as large-scale in-memory databases, high-performance computing, data analytics pipelines, and memory-heavy enterprise applications.
